title: TractionCurrentPersistenceSpecificationSchema
description: Validation schema defining vehicle-specific traction current persistence criteria, signal processing parameters, and physical safety endpoint separation for electrical traction de-energization.

vehicle_configuration.powertrain_type: 48V DC Battery Powered 3-Phase AC Electric Industrial Truck

traction_inverter.model: Curtis 1238E-5421 / Sevcon Gen4 48V 350A AC Motor Controller

current_sensing_chain.probe_model: Tektronix TCP303 AC/DC Current Probe with TCPA300 Amplifier

signal_processing_frozen_specification.rms_formula: I_RMS(t) = sqrt((1/N) * sum(i(t - tau)^2)) for tau in [0, T_window]

persistence_parameter_specification.approval_basis: Empirical characterization of motor L/R decay time (3*tau = 14.8 ms worst-case, gate-off freewheel diode clamp active in < 3.0 ms) combined with 2.0 ms sliding RMS integration filter latency. A 10.0 ms continuous window filters all 10 kHz PWM ripple and AC zero-crossing false detections while guaranteeing total electrical latency <= 48.8 ms within the 50.0 ms guarded budget.
persistence_parameter_specification.condition: I_motor_RMS(t) < 0.5 A continuously for delta_t >= 10.0 ms without single-sample excursion

states.definition: Instantaneous physical opening of the dual-channel normally-closed E-Stop push button (24V -> 0V).
Safety relay internal logic drops de-energizing coil outputs (OSSD drop).
Main traction contactor auxiliary status microswitch physically breaks contact.
AUTHORITATIVE ELECTRICAL ENDPOINT: Phase U line current falls below 0.5 A RMS continuously for T_persist >= 10.0 ms.
Galvanic disconnection of battery pack and voltage discharge of inverter DC link bulk capacitors (V_bus < 50.0 VDC). Measured independently via high-voltage probe.
Electrical supply to spring-applied mechanical brake solenoid cut (24V -> 0V).
Mechanical friction brake pads clamp against rotor; measured via caliper travel sensor or deceleration onset.
Chassis velocity = 0.0 m/s; measured via wheel speed encoder frequency = 0 Hz.

endpoint_state_separation.non_conflation_mandate: ELECTRICAL_TRACTION_DEENERGIZED (I < 0.5 A RMS) DOES NOT prove DC_BUS_ISOLATED, MECHANICAL_BRAKE_APPLIED, or VEHICLE_MOTION_STOPPED.
